review.description: Credentials and unrelated private work remain excluded; the new reporting contract adds private scoped evidence and sanitized publication excerpts.
review.implementation: Report redaction replaces vault/owner secrets and common authentication fields before persistence. Scoped run and repository evidence excludes unrelated records; journal report events contain only ID/status. Unknown unquoted authorization schemes now redact the entire header value, and structured Proxy-Authorization keys share the sensitive-key filter before retention. Existing cookie/header-array redaction now also consumes complete serialized authorization/proxy arrays in string evidence, using the same narrow header owner. Credential traversal now recognizes decoded nested MCP text and sensitive two-element header records, sharing the existing value walker and preserving complete raw header spans before fragment parsing.
review.tests: Read evidence assertions for secret removal, unrelated run/repository omission, immutable captured launch state, explicit omissions, hashes and mode-0600 evidence files. Inspected additional Negotiate/Custom/Digest observations, structured scalar/array proxy headers and persisted additions/findings; regression proves unknown proofs absent across private files, investigator input and publication while unrelated evidence lines remain. Inspected multi-line/double-quoted authorization arrays and single-quoted proxy arrays with proofs absent from the vault; storage, investigator and publication assertions reject every proof while adjacent fields survive. Actual structured/serialized Authorization pairs and escaped nested Authorization/Cookie proofs absent from the vault fail before repair and pass across retained reports/files, investigator input and re-sanitized publication. JSON-looking raw headers retain whole-value redaction while neighboring lines/outer data survive.
